title: SGLang HiCache: reuse prefixes only when transfer beats recomputation
summary: Move reusable prefix KV across device, host and storage tiers while accounting for sharing scope, layout conversion and prefetch policy.

hardware: GPU plus CPU memory and optional storage/network backend; CUDA transfer path is the scope of this candidate
software: sgl-project/sglang at f7ad4345b86d147a1c3095a3cebabca9a33ebaa1; later revisions need reinspection
conditions: Repeated prefixes or long contexts with measurable reuse
Model/cache identity and distributed-rank agreement must be maintained

claims.description: HiCache keeps L1 device and L2 host caches private to an inference instance; only appropriately configured L3 storage enables cross-instance reuse.
Page-oriented layouts, selective write-through and prefetch termination policies trade I/O overhead against useful cache hits. Multi-rank consensus constrains usable prefix lengths.

downstream_impact: vLLM: candidate experiment for long-context or repeated-prefix serving; compare transfer cost with recomputation under the actual hit-rate distribution.
vLLM-Omni: consider only stages with genuinely reusable prefix KV; diffusion residual caching is a different technique.
vllm-ascend: the hierarchy is a design hypothesis, with NPU I/O and layout behavior requiring separate validation.
recommendations: Treat downstream impact as an InferRSI transfer hypothesis, not an upstream compatibility or performance result.
validation_plan: Compare cold cache, warm device cache, host hits and storage hits with identical request order; report TTFT, throughput, transfer bytes and hit rates.
Test cache keys for model/revision/adapter differences, eviction, partial prefetch and rank disagreement.
limitations: No SGLang benchmark gain is imported as an InferRSI result.
Larger private host caches do not create a shared distributed cache; low reuse or slow storage can regress latency.
Point-in-time source extraction, not a historical commit-delta audit. No local accelerator or model-quality reproduction was run.
